plan.formulation: Conditionally replace only the exhaustive partition search with a binary weighted-Max-Cut formulation. Let x_i=1 exactly when equipment position i is assigned to window 0, and define C(x)=sum_{i<j} w_ij(x_i+x_j-2*x_i*x_j). Minimizing conflict weight is equivalent to maximizing C because the aggregated total weight is assignment-independent. To preserve the required tie rule, minimize the QUBO E(x)=-(2^n)*C(x)+sum_i(2^i*x_i); the factor 2^n makes any integral one-unit cut improvement dominate the complete tie term. All bit strings are feasible because either window may be empty. If converted to Ising form, use x_i=(1-Z_i)/2 and explicitly retain the resulting constants, signs, linear terms, pair terms, and coefficient precision.
plan.input_encoding: Use the validated equipment positions and symmetric aggregated integer matrix returned by prepare_request. Encode one binary variable per equipment item, including isolated items because their bits affect the canonical tie-break. Zero-weight pairs need no cut interaction. Arbitrary-precision input weights and the 2^n objective scale must be represented without coefficient truncation that could change the optimum.
plan.quantum_algorithm_family: QAOA-style QUBO/Ising optimization, usable only under an unresolved procedure that certifies the exact lexicographic optimum required by the software contract
plan.output_decoding: Decode each measured bit string as window 0 containing indices with x_i=1 and window 1 containing the remaining indices, both in increasing input position. Recompute C, conflict weight, and the mask sum classically using arbitrary-precision integers. Select the greatest cut weight and then the smallest mask among decoded candidates. Accept a replacement result only if exact global optimality, including the tie-break, is certified; otherwise retain the classical solver. Pass the decoded windows through the unchanged evaluate_windows and compare_assignments functions.
assumptions: prepare_request has already completed all validation and aggregation before the candidate region is activated.
The aggregated total edge weight is constant across assignments, so maximizing separated weight exactly minimizes conflict weight.
Weights are nonnegative integers and all binary assignments, including empty windows, are feasible.

Finite coefficient precision or rescaling can invalidate both the primary objective and the canonical tie-break, especially with arbitrary-precision weights.
The objective interactions, state preparation, parameter optimization, measurements, and classical decoding may cost more than the bounded classical search.
No black-box oracle is supplied; objective-phase compilation or any reversible cost evaluation, including ancillas and uncomputation, remains unresolved.
Sampling only some optimal assignments can return the wrong tied partition even when the optimal cut value is observed.
Independent exact certification may require exhaustive classical work, eliminating any proposed benefit.
